name: Captain Britain

abilityDetails.Safeguard: Vurulurken veya bloklarken herhangi bir kaynaktan alınabilecek can kaybını belirli bir yüzdeyle sınırlar.
abilityDetails.Exhaustion: Rakibin kritik vuruş gücünü ve tetiklenme oranını azaltır.
abilityDetails.Neuroshock: Rakibe zamanla yüksek elektrik tabanlı hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Slow: Düşmanın Durdurulamaz (Unstoppable) ve Kaçış (Evade) yeteneklerini iptal eder.
abilityDetails.Power Efficiency: Özel saldırıların güç maliyetini belirtilen güçte azaltır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Kritik vurma, kanama/şok uygulama, herhangi bir negatif efekti purify etme veya exhaustion altındayken vurma — bunların hepsi ona ölümcül nörşok tetikler. Kritik vuramayan şampiyonlar avantajlı.
signatureAbility:
Pure Soul
Increase personal Exhaustion duration by [3 - 10]% for each Psionic Charge. Psionic Mode increases the duration as if Captain Britain has 10 Psionic Charges.
Each personal Neuroshock reduces the Opponent's Energy Resistance by [15 - 35]% of their current positive Energy Resistance. Max: 100%.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Basic attacks deal Energy Damage instead of Physical.
Against non-Tech Champions, Captain Britain's personal Neuroshock and Exhaustion Passives cannot have their duration or Ability Accuracy reduced.
Captain Britain starts each fight with a 3% Safeguard Passive. When inflicted with a Special Power Drain effect, or, as an Attacker, after reducing a hit's damage, this Safeguard is removed.
When this Safeguard is removed or prevented, Captain Britain regains it after 20 seconds unless she's suffering from a Special Power Drain effect.
When either Champion is knocked down, or Captain Britain is struck by a Critical Hit, the Opponent is inflicted with a non-stacking [687.5] Exhaustion Passive for 4 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Neuroshock
content: Captain Britain's Neuroshock Passives deal [2,639.75] Energy Damage over 10 seconds, scaling with Base Attack only.
The potency of her Neuroshocks is increased by Captain Britain's current Prowess potency, but doubly reduced by her current Cowardice potency. Max: 200% increased potency at +200% Prowess.
When inflicted with a Shock or Bleed effect, inflict a Neuroshock Passive.
If struck by or striking an Opponent suffering from an Exhaustion effect, inflict a Neuroshock Passive. Can only trigger once every 1.5 seconds.
Whenever the Opponent Purifies or Cleanses a Debuff, inflict 2 Neuroshock Passives.

abilitySections.title: Psionic Charges - Max: 20
content: When inflicting a personal Neuroshock or gaining any Prowess effect, gain 1 indefinite Psionic Charge.
When activating a Special Attack, gain 6 indefinite Psionic Charges.
When knocked down, gain 2 indefinite Psionic Charges.
When inflicted with a Cowardice or Special Power Drain effect, remove 2 Psionic Charges.
If knocked down while one of these effects is active, remove 2 Psionic Charges for each unique effect, up to a max of 4 Charges.

abilitySections.title: Psionic Mode
content: When reaching 10 or more Psionic Charges, if not already active, enter Psionic Mode. Psionic Mode lasts for 1 second per Psionic Charge when activated, paused during Special Attacks. While in Psionic Mode, Captain Britain cannot gain Psionic Charges, and gains the following:
Personal Neuroshock Passives tick 200% faster. Any personal Neuroshock Passives inflicted during Psionic Mode are paused until Psionic Mode ends.
When activating a Special Attack, for each level of the Special, gain 1 indefinite +15% Prowess Passive. When Psionic Mode ends, remove 3 personal Prowesses. Max stacks: 30.
Captain Britain is Stun Immune during her Dash and Medium Attacks.
As a Defender, Psionic Mode goes on cooldown for 15 seconds after it ends.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation, inflict a non-stacking [11.04] Exhaustion Passive for 6 seconds.
Each hit inflicts a Slow Debuff for 16 seconds. If Purified by a Skill Champion, inflict a matching Slow Passive. While active, Captain Britain's personal Exhaustion are paused.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: On activation, gain a non-stacking +[2,750] Bulwark Passive lasting until the next time Psionic Mode ends.
While this Bulwark is active, Basic Attacks inflict a Neuroshock Passive. This can trigger through Block.
Hits in this Special Attack gain +[6,416.67] Critical Rating.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: This Special Attack cannot be activated if Psionic Mode is active.
Enter Psionic Mode and increase its duration by +8 seconds.
Gain a non-stacking 60% Power Efficiency Passive lasting until Psionic Mode Expires.
Gain 6 additional indefinite +15% Prowess Passives.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Pure Soul
content: Increase personal Exhaustion duration by [3 - 10]% for each Psionic Charge. Psionic Mode increases the duration as if Captain Britain has 10 Psionic Charges.
Each personal Neuroshock reduces the Opponent's Energy Resistance by [15 - 35]% of their current positive Energy Resistance. Max: 100%.
